healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Skilled nursing centers, assisted and independent living, memory care, homecare, hospice, and geriatric psychiatric hospitals

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Senior care: skilled nursing, rehabilitation, memory care, geriatric psychiatry, hospice, pharmacy

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Network of senior care centers and campuses across ten states, with licensed nursing and living beds

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Mix of post-acute skilled nursing and rehabilitation, long-term care, memory care, and lower-acuity assisted and independent living

clinical_operating_quality.label: Clinical operating quality
clinical_operating_quality.value: Stated quality commitment through the 'Better Way 20 promises' patient and resident satisfaction program; no clinical metric given
